But also — my engine builds states only for ticks it visits (0..R) — a query tick > R would KeyError. Contract guarantees queries in [0,R] ✓ so fine, but let me make run_replay defensive anyway (states.get). Actually simpler: fix the tests to always set queries within range.

Let me fix: fab9b and fab9d traces add queries=[0] or none... default queries=[3] with rounds=3 is ok for fab9c (R=3 ✓ query 3 ✓). For fab9b (rounds=2) query 3 invalid — set queries=[2]. For the last guard test (rounds=2) also queries=[2].

Also engine robustness: use `states.setdefault(t, ...)`... I'll make out_states use states.get with a constructed default — not needed per contract but cheap. I'll leave the engine (contract-guaranteed) but fix tests.
